$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=3{x}_{1}(t) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=-2{x}_{1}(t)+{x}_{2}(t)+3,\end{aligned}\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the initial value problem above. By applying the Laplace transform $L$ to both sides of each equation in our system, we get a system with variables ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}.$ In terms of the parameter $s,$ the solution of the new system is

${X}_{1}(s)=-\frac{1}{s-3},\,$
${X}_{2}(s)=$ {{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
First, we compute the Laplace transforms of both sides of each equation in our system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}L\{{x}_{1}^{′}(t)\}=L\{3{x}_{1}(t)\} \\ L\{{x}_{2}^{′}(t)\}=L\{-2{x}_{1}(t)+{x}_{2}(t)+3\}\end{aligned}\,\,
$$

Using the derivative property of the Laplace transform, we obtain the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}sL\{{x}_{1}(t)\}-{x}_{1}(0)=3L\{{x}_{1}(t)\} \\ sL\{{x}_{2}(t)\}-{x}_{2}(0)=-2L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}+L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}+3L\{1\}\end{aligned}
$$

which can be simplified to the following:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s)+1=3{X}_{1}(s) \\ s{X}_{2}(s)-2=-2{X}_{1}(s)+{X}_{2}(s)+\frac{3}{s}\end{aligned}
$$

where ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\},$ and we have used the fact that $L\{1\}=\frac{1}{s}.$

Now, solving the first equation for ${X}_{1}(s),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s)+1 & =3{X}_{1}(s) \\ (s-3){X}_{1}(s) & =-1 \\ {X}_{1}(s) & =-\frac{1}{s-3}.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting this in the second equation and solving for ${X}_{2}(s),$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}s{X}_{2}(s)-2 & =-2{X}_{1}(s)+{X}_{2}(s)+\frac{3}{s} \\ (s-1){X}_{2}(s) & =-2{X}_{1}(s)+2+\frac{3}{s} \\ (s-1){X}_{2}(s) & =-2(-\frac{1}{s-3})+2+\frac{3}{s} \\ (s-1){X}_{2}(s) & =(\frac{2}{s-3})+(\frac{2s+3}{s}) \\ (s-1){X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{2s+(2s+3)(s-3)}{s(s-3)} \\ (s-1){X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{2s+(2{s}^{2}-3s-9)}{s(s-3)} \\ (s-1){X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{2{s}^{2}-s-9}{s(s-3)} \\ {X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{2{s}^{2}-s-9}{s(s-1)(s-3)}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution of the new system in terms of parameter $s$ is 

$$
{X}_{1}(s)=-\frac{1}{s-3},\,{X}_{2}(s)=\frac{2{s}^{2}-s-9}{s(s-1)(s-3)}.
$$
